market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver's all-time high is ~$50/oz (1980, 2011), and current price is ~$24. Reaching $120 would require a >5x move in 18 months, which is far outside any historical precedent or fundamental scenario. Even hyperinflation or massive supply shock seems insufficient, making YES effectively impossible.
evidence_points: Silver all-time high is ~$50 (1980, 2011) – less than half the target.
Current price ~$24 implies a 5x rally needed.
No historical precedent for such a rapid surge; massive speculative bubble required.
